answer: Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The atlas graph is validated at intake and the timber frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and glacier anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Forging one identity takes 5 hours and a real hardware anchor; forging 682 takes that multiplied out, plus 51 thousand dollars of collateral sitting idle. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
